_purpose: THE definition of 'the final my-agent architecture' for the 20-competition re-run. Every competition names exactly ONE workspace, ONE eval module and ONE search driver. Without this file the re-run is undefined: s3e1 has 13 eval modules and s5e1 has 7, so 're-run with the final architecture' would mean a different thing on every relaunch, making the run neither reproducible nor comparable to the frozen AIDE/NVIDIA yardsticks (2026-08-04 finding).

_rules.eval_module: the canonical evaluator: the plain eval_<comp>.py, or its _v2 where a v2 superseded it. Variant evaluators (eval_ratio_*, eval_featurejoin_*, eval_*_v5_*) are ARM evaluators generated per-run by make_v5_arm and are never the competition's own.
_rules.driver: For a FRESH benchmark run, EVERY competition's driver is skill-generated by copying tree_search/run_template_v3.py (competition-agnostic) and filling it from that run's own Stage 1-3 artifacts; the generated path MUST be recorded into 'driver_actual' before the run counts. The dedicated run_<comp>_v3.py files embed their competition's RECORDED root configs, champion parameters and digit-verify targets -- they exist to REPRODUCE recorded trees and must never seed a fresh run (2026-08-10 round-6: pinning them here would have warm-started each lane from its own recorded answer). They stay pinned below under 'reproduction_driver' for the reproduction use-case only.
_rules.harness: harness_v3 for all competitions (unified blend scoring per 5b2c7af); harness_v2 only as the library harness_v3 delegates to.
_rules.launcher: run_myagent_headless.sh, one competition at a time under the lane lock, workspaces archived first (prep B).
